name: terminal-continuation-failures

graded_by.test: owed: recording_continuation_terminal_continuation_failures_u2: fault-injection tests for every listed continuation scenario

description: Provider failure cuts and expected durable state for recording continuations.

expect: generation 1 is spent
reserve a later generation
no unlinked pair is activated
halt the episode
keep and report any orphan found
never adopt or delete it

steps: interrupt the link append before LF
expect: repair only the unterminated audit tail
pair without a link is an orphan
allocate a new generation

steps: append complete link and crash before active switch
expect: validate and sync the surviving link
activate its pair once
do not allocate another successor

steps: leave an LF-complete malformed or conflicting link
expect: preserve the malformed line
hold and report
do not classify the pair as orphan or activate it

steps: create and sync a new pair
expect: link durability precedes active switch
empty successor offset is zero
session counters are inherited
record end and lifecycle event once
reconcile the surviving link
write one effective original end in successor

steps: quarantine at output seq 40 and committed bytes 8000
restart with ring first buffered seq 45
fail sync of the successor gap before commit
expect: quarantine successor at its own last P
halt until next start
rederive the gap using inherited session-wide counters and the new hello
halt the episode
do not use the successor
preserve any orphan found on restart
quarantine the successor at its last P
never cut or append its suffix
halt without another pair in the episode

steps: restart and switch to a continuation
expect: do not read the old suffix for a sequence floor
first assigned continuation input seq exceeds 1024
do not reuse an input sequence

steps: exhaust the current input sequence reservation
fail the bbolt write for the next reservation
expect: refuse input before assigning above the durable high-water
do not forward the refused input

steps: recover a quarantined pair with no durable input sequence reservation
expect: hold and report
do not infer a floor from the suffix

steps: fail recording syncs for two sessions sharing a connection
expect: hold each session independently
keep shared control and heartbeats
do not apply a connection-level end

steps: attach a client during the hold
expect: send retained-grid prefix then one data_path lost
refuse input recording_unavailable
send no held output

steps: fail the audit write for the alert raise
expect: keep the in-process alert and log the failure
rebuild the alert from the bbolt held state

steps: establish the end marker within the durable prefix
expect: do not create a continuation
do not write a second end
replay is validation only

steps: recover a quarantined record that lacks end placement
expect: hold and report
never inspect the suffix to decide the end

steps: retain a session with a quarantined predecessor
the worker connection closes before complete accounting
expect: apply the existing closure notice
do not send release_accounted
keep the unknown suffix explicit

steps: worker replay ends before the preserved suffix would
expect: record only replayed output
do not compare the unconfirmed suffix
do not infer a loss from old physical length

steps: the next hello says there is nothing to replay
expect: the successor stays empty until later output
do not count or compare suffix bytes
P remains the initial successor baseline

steps: create and sync an empty successor
fail fsync of its audit link
expect: do not activate or write the successor
halt until the next start
classify only after audit repair

steps: apply the in-process input and write barrier
expect: keep the in-process hold
log the failed persistence
state the residual that a later process may not see the hold

steps: accept input before the failure barrier
forward one recorded input and leave another queued
expect: keep the forwarded input in the unconfirmed predecessor evidence
refuse the unforwarded input
never claim refused input was delivered

steps: receive replay_done before the final data frame
expect: do not send live before both replay barriers
record each replayed frame exactly once

steps: fail to restore a compatible snapshot at P
expect: raise the existing grid_lost stale path
do not feed the old suffix to reconstruct a grid
preserve any already pending stale choice

steps: retain a VT grid that applied output above P
expect: replace the retained grid
feed each replay frame once
do not apply old unconfirmed output

steps: create a successor that commits no frames
expect: the successor has its own generation-specific quarantine fact
the next successor inherits the same session-wide P
do not collide with the predecessor notice

steps: fail the quarantine notice audit append
expect: keep the in-process hold
report the failure
do not claim another process can reconstruct a missing notice
no commit write moves the held pair above P
bbolt remains at P until active switch
